title: A Two-Stage Spatiotemporal Flood-Risk Framework with Flood-Aware Emergency Routing and Hybrid Quantum Dispatch for a Single-Orbit Coastal District
description:
Reproducible research pipeline accompanying the manuscript of the same name. Covers a multi-temporal Sentinel-1 SAR flood-frequency inventory built under a single-orbit (~12-day revisit) constraint over Dakshina Kannada, Karnataka, India; a calibrated, SHAP-explainable static susceptibility model with an explicit NDVI/land-cover confound ablation; a rainfall-driven temporal trigger validated against two documented flood events plus an adversarial heavy-rain non-flood day; flood-aware emergency routing over an OpenStreetMap graph with hand-implemented, search-transparent Dijkstra and A*; and a 9-qubit QUBO/QAOA ambulance dispatch layer verified exactly against the Hungarian algorithm.

A dependency-aware build system regenerates every figure, table and reported value in the manuscript from public source data. An automated test suite encodes the methodological invariants as executable assertions.
